correctness.rationale: An exact torus coordinate transformation gives x^N=f(t), the t=1 valuation proves geometric irreducibility, and derivative f'(t) has a single simple critical parameter. The M distinct x-roots are all singularities; formal coordinate changes give each v²=u^{p^e} and delta (p^e−1)/2. A Frobenius function-field isomorphism identifies the normalization with the separable degree-M Kummer cover. Tame Riemann--Hurwitz and pointwise unibranch normalization prove genus and all-extension zeta equality. Standalone exact point counts independently corroborate n=2,3,4,5,6,8,19,31 examples. Infinite proof is algebraic, not computational extrapolation.

value.rationale: The theorem solves a natural characteristic-boundary question for the classical Hurwitz family uniformly in n and p, turning an arbitrarily high-genus smooth plane model into explicitly classified wild cusps and a tame Kummer normalization of much smaller genus. It determines the exact genus collapse and preservation of zeta under normalization, including rational-degeneration instances whenever N is a prime power (for example n=19,p=7). This geometric classification is not a routine re-labeling or one small finite numerical slice.
